summary: Ares Capital Corporation filed an 8-K announcing the establishment of a commercial paper program. The program allows the company to issue up to $1 billion in short-term unsecured commercial paper notes with maturities up to 397 days. The notes will be sold in private placements to dealers under customary terms. Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. No notes have been issued yet. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation event such as an acquisition or restructuring.
